title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Abhimaan
desc: After disowning his daughter years ago, an elderly businessman now seeks the help of his grandson to mend his relationship with her.

title: Baba Keno Chakar
desc: When Rajnarayan asks his son to help out with the expenses for his sister's wedding, he refuses. As a result, he is forced to go from pillar to post to make ends meet.

title: Kamalar Banabas
desc: Banished from the kingdom under false pretences, Kamala endures hardship while raising her son, determined to clear her name and reunite with her loved ones.

title: Handa and Bhonda
desc: The spirit of a man's late wife grants the wishes of her husband and her son for seven days in hopes that they find common ground with one another.
